post.originalText:
I asked Opus 5.5 to make a 90-second video about the history of technology.

It found a better story: the first words ever sent through our machines.

1844 — telegraph
1876 — telephone
1969 — ARPANET
Today — AI

“150 years of calling, and now the line replies: I’m here.”
🔊🔊 https://t.co/7uLKmm2oHT
